work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent LX 25315, synopsis 25317–25320 and Urbanus self-protocol 25322–25323 introduce earlier Gregory XV letters at 25325–25327. Exact embedded letter runs 25329–25486, including its own protocol and 1622 dating; current Urbanus narration resumes at section 6, 25488, then section 7 modifies the earlier provisions and closes with present dating 25553–25557. Historical correction notes 25356 and 25471 belong to the embedded wording and remain included. Next independent LXI starts 25560; nested papal testimony is explicitly bounded rather than treated as another current act.
